style_suggestion.reasoning: Site calls itself a 'modern venue' with 'contemporary' rooms, industrial ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows (Modern). Rules list 'rooftop' as a Luxury cue, so the corrected Description still yields Modern + Luxury. If the team wants Luxury to mean truly upscale, 'rooftop' alone is a weak cue; this is a mid-priced all-inclusive hall.
